messages:
pagerduty-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT triggered: billing-heartbeat-sag in eu1 (P2). Metric: billing.heartbeat.ms has a 3x drop since 02:10 UTC. Auto-alerted oncall.

sam: oncall here, picking up. seeing the pager, starting checks.

jordan: I can run a quick usage-recon query. thinking it's a late-emit from kafka consumer lag.

lee: confirmed small window of delayed writes to metering-db around 02:09-02:12. snapshot: `select count(*) from usage_events where ts between '2026-03-20 02:09' and '2026-03-20 02:12';` returned 0 rows for one partition.

sam: thanks. @jordan can you run the producer/consumer offsets and show lag?

jordan: running now; output: ```
consumer_group: metering-consumer-eu1
partition 12: lag=12400
partition 13: lag=0
partition 14: lag=8800
```

emily: looks like a transient GC pause on one of the metering workers earlier. I see `Stop-The-World` logs at 02:08:58 on metering-worker-5.

mike: any customer-facing overage flags yet?

sam: quick check: alerting shows ~0 overage flags fired in last 15m. billing thresholds haven't tripped. customer reports: none so far.

jordan: mitigation plan: 1) bump consumer parallelism on eu1 by +2 2) restart metering-worker-5 3) run backfill job to replay lagged offsets. Doing 1 now.

lee: +1 to restart, but let's avoid flapping same worker. recommend restart after bumping parallelism.

sam: executing bump and scheduling restart. Also enabling short-term duplication guard in recon pipeline to avoid double-counts during replay.

jordan: bump completed. verified consumers now: ```
partition 12: lag=4200 -> 300
partition 14: lag=8800 -> 900
```

emily: restart queued for metering-worker-5, rolling restart in 2 mins.

mike: quick customer impact note: replay will cause delayed usage to appear in reports; unit counts may shift for a few customers but no billing overages expected. recommend holding manual customer notifications until recon finishes.

sam: adding incident tag, creating ticket INF-3921 for backfill verification and postmortem. assigning to eng-metric-team.

pagerduty-bot: reminder: oncall escalation window ends in 35m.

jordan: backfill started. tailing logs: ```
[02:18:12] replay: partition 12 replayed 11,800 events
[02:18:16] replay: partition 14 replayed 7,900 events
```

emily: recon job checksums match expected ledger totals for the window.

sam: closing pager for now — monitoring for 30m. no customer-facing overages. postmortem + runbook update assigned. :white_check_mark:

mike: thanks team. I'll prep a short summary for SRE/CS if anything Customer Success needs.

lee: note for postmortem: consider adding JVM memory alert with STW threshold to avoid GC-induced gaps.

sam: noted. incident -> status: mitigated, follow-ups INF-3921 (backfill verification), INF-3922 (runbook/GCal oncall JVM alert).

pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT resolved: billing-heartbeat-sag in eu1 (resolved by sam).
